description: OS Open Greenspace is Ordnance Survey's open dataset of publicly accessible green spaces across Great Britain, including public parks, playing fields, sports facilities, play areas and allotments, with access points for entering and leaving urban and rural green spaces. It is updated every six months and offered as vector data. OS presents uses in planning new recreational areas, public health planning alongside GP, pharmacy and school locations and deprivation data, and emergency response, since site use and access points help crews reach incidents faster. Related OS products include the more detailed OS MasterMap Greenspace Layer and OS Land Use Features. Coverage: England, Scotland and Wales. Access: free download with documentation. Licence: OS OpenData, free to use for everyone. Caveats: it covers publicly accessible green space only, not private gardens, and the detailed MasterMap layer is a separate product. Simulation uses: green space locations and entrances for access, heat, flood and evacuation analyses. Related records: OpenStreetMap parks and ParkServe.
